metadata.description: Primary references for systematic debugging, safe production investigation, profiling, distributed tracing, agent/LLM debugging security, deterministic record-and-replay debugging, and validated-corpus search-first triage (verified July 2026).
metadata.title: QA Debugging - Sources

observability_standards.name: OpenTelemetry Zero-Code Instrumentation
observability_standards.description: Current zero-code instrumentation guidance, including eBPF-based approaches.

observability_standards.name: OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions
observability_standards.description: Current GenAI tracing attributes, agent spans, MCP tool call spans, and content-capture events. Status as of 2026-07-11: primary sources conflict on gen_ai.client span stability (some early-2026 reports say stable; the OTel semconv pages were still labeled Development as of May 2026) -- verify against opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/gen-ai/ before relying on it; gen_ai.agent spans and the overall convention set remain Development/experimental. Switch to the latest experimental attribute set via OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN=gen_ai_latest_experimental (default still emits pre-v1.36 attributes).

observability_standards.name: OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation (OBI)
observability_standards.description: Official OTel project form of Grafana Beyla's instrumentation engine (donated 2025). Zero-code OTLP span emission for Go, Python, Node.js, Java, and Rust via eBPF uprobes.

observability_standards.name: The Twelve-Factor App - Logs
observability_standards.description: Logs as event streams; useful baseline for debugging in cloud environments.

record_and_replay.name: rr: lightweight recording & deterministic debugging
record_and_replay.description: Mozilla-originated deterministic record-and-replay debugger for Linux. v5.9.0 (Feb 2024): works with perf_event_paranoid=2 on Linux ≥ 6.10. v5.8.0 added lldb support. AArch64 now production-quality. Use rr.soft for VMs without HW perf counters.

record_and_replay.name: rr.soft — rr without hardware performance counters
record_and_replay.description: Runs rr in a Linux VM on Apple Silicon macOS or cloud VMs lacking CPU hardware performance counters. Use rr record -W for software-counter mode. Supports x86-64 and AArch64 Linux.

record_and_replay.name: Pernosco — Omniscient Debugging
record_and_replay.description: Omniscient debugger built on top of rr recordings. Builds a complete CPU-state database from the recording for instant time-travel. Targets C, C++, Ada, Rust, and V8 JS on x86-64 Linux. Free for approved open-source projects; hosted and on-premises for teams.

profiling_and_debuggers.name: Chrome DevTools - Performance
profiling_and_debuggers.description: Frontend and Node.js performance profiling workflows.

profiling_and_debuggers.name: Chrome DevTools - Memory Problems
profiling_and_debuggers.description: Official browser memory leak and heap investigation workflows.

profiling_and_debuggers.name: Node.js - Using Heap Snapshot
profiling_and_debuggers.description: Official Node.js heap snapshot workflow for leak debugging.

profiling_and_debuggers.name: Node.js - Using Linux perf
profiling_and_debuggers.description: Official low-level CPU investigation workflow for Linux production systems.

profiling_and_debuggers.name: Python Logging HOWTO
profiling_and_debuggers.description: Official Python logging guidance and patterns.

databases.name: PostgreSQL - pg_stat_statements
databases.description: Server-side query performance statistics for debugging slow queries.

ai_assisted_debugging.name: Langfuse Documentation
ai_assisted_debugging.description: LLM tracing, evaluations, prompt/version tracking, and cost debugging workflows.

ai_assisted_debugging.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
ai_assisted_debugging.description: Current OWASP baseline for LLM application risks relevant to AI-assisted debugging.

ai_assisted_debugging.name: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications for 2026
ai_assisted_debugging.description: Agent-specific failure and abuse modes relevant to agent/tool debugging in 2026.

ai_assisted_debugging.name: OWASP Practical Guide for Secure MCP Server Development
ai_assisted_debugging.description: Security controls for MCP servers and tool integrations used during debugging.

distributed_tracing_and_profiles.name: SigNoz Documentation
distributed_tracing_and_profiles.description: OTel-native traces, metrics, and logs reference for debugging workflows.

distributed_tracing_and_profiles.name: Grafana Pyroscope Documentation
distributed_tracing_and_profiles.description: Continuous profiling reference for intermittent CPU and memory issues. Pyroscope 2.0 (announced 2026-04-21) is a ground-up rearchitecture: single-write-once storage with symbol deduplication (up to 95% symbol-storage reduction in Grafana's own production use) and stateless querying.

distributed_tracing_and_profiles.name: Sentry Profiling Documentation
distributed_tracing_and_profiles.description: Continuous and sampled profiling workflows tied to errors and traces.

knowledge_corpus_search.name: Stack Exchange API v2.3 — search/advanced
knowledge_corpus_search.description: Public Q&A search API behind community Stack Overflow MCP servers. Search-first triage for recognizable errors before deep debugging. API key raises rate limits only (not a secret).

knowledge_corpus_search.name: @gscalzo/stackoverflow-mcp (community MCP server)
knowledge_corpus_search.description: Community MCP server over the Stack Exchange API. Tools: search_by_error, search_by_tags, analyze_stack_trace. Install: npx -y @gscalzo/stackoverflow-mcp. Verify tool surface before citing.

knowledge_corpus_search.name: Stack Overflow for Agents (beta — confirmed launched, endpoint details still unverified)
knowledge_corpus_search.description: API-first validated-answer exchange, publicly announced by Stack Overflow on 2026-06-10 (stackoverflow.blog): search before burning tokens, optional human-approved write-back (TILs/Questions/Blueprints). API keys + operator SSO. Product existence and launch date are confirmed via the primary announcement; exact endpoint paths and request/response shapes were not independently re-verified here — confirm against agents.stackoverflow.com/llms.txt before wiring any call.
